caption:
Apple made another move against browser tracking in Safari, and now ad tech companies are scrambling to shift their identity tools over to servers instead. Every time tech giants tighten privacy rules, marketers have to rebuild the entire plumbing just to keep track of clicks. How long until ads just follow us into our group chats? 📱💸

What do you think is next for targeted ads?

@apple

Source: Digiday

#AdTech #MarketingNews #DigitalMarketing #Privacy #Apple

post.news: Apple blocked more browser tracking in Safari, forcing ad tech companies and publishers to rush toward server-side solutions like the IAB Tech Lab framework.
post.take: Privacy is just a great excuse to lock the doors and keep all the ad money inside the house.
post.insight: When browsers block tracking on the device, the ad industry simply moves the servers behind the wall. Privacy updates always change where the plumbing goes.
